scenarios.description: Move the bracket order immediately to the alternate CNC to protect due time with minimal delay.
schedule_delta: Move ORD-7712 from CNC-102 0.0-2.0 to CNC-104 0.0-2.0
scenarios.tradeoff_summary: This keeps the urgent work on time with almost no disruption, but it uses the backup CNC right away and leaves less room for other reroutes.

scenarios.description: Wait for CNC-102 to recover and run the bracket order there after downtime.
schedule_delta: Delay ORD-7712 on CNC-102 from 0.0-2.0 to 0.75-2.75 after machine recovery
scenarios.tradeoff_summary: This avoids shifting work across machines and is simplest to run, but it accepts some delay and less schedule cushion before the due time.

scenarios.description: Start the bracket order on the alternate CNC after a short buffer, preserving flexibility on the backup machine.
schedule_delta: Move ORD-7712 to CNC-104 and run it at 0.75-2.75 instead of CNC-102 0.0-2.0
scenarios.tradeoff_summary: This keeps the order safe from the outage while holding the backup machine open briefly, but it gives up some due-date cushion versus starting immediately.
